description: This file defines the Sum class, which extends AbstractStorelessUnivariateStatistic, providing methods to compute and manage the sum of a dataset, including incremental updates, evaluation over arrays, and copying functionality.

classes.name: Sum
classes.description: A class for computing the sum of dataset values, supporting incremental updates, array evaluations, and copying.

methods.name: Sum()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the sum object.

methods.name: Sum(Sum original)
methods.description: Copy constructor creating a new Sum instance with the same state as the original.

methods.name: increment(double d)
methods.description: Adds a value to the current sum and increments the count.

methods.name: getResult()
methods.description: Returns the current sum of all added values.

methods.name: getN()
methods.description: Returns the number of values added.

methods.name: clear()
methods.description: Resets the sum and count to zero.

methods.name: evaluate(double[] values, int begin, int length)
methods.description: Calculates the sum of a subarray of values.

methods.name: evaluate(double[] values, double[] weights, int begin, int length)
methods.description: Calculates the weighted sum of a subarray with specified weights.

methods.name: evaluate(double[] values, double[] weights)
methods.description: Calculates the weighted sum of the entire array with specified weights.

methods.name: copy()
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Sum instance.
